summary: The pebble-word idea runs in the sandbox and is new: HI was read right on try 2 in my own run and nine friends waved. But what a player sees is a scatter of grey stones among flowers, with no letter visible, so the event is hard to follow by eye.
surprise_why: A real text-reading model decides whether the friends' written word counts, and it fails in funny ways, which is a different kind of mechanic from the scripted gatherings.
